name: Indian Standards (IS)
description: Indian Standards, loads (alpha 9 track C7): unit weights (IS 875 Part 1), imposed loads and their reduction (Part 2), wind by the design wind speed Vz = Vb k1 k2 k3 k4 (Part 3:2015), load combinations (Part 5 with IS 456 Table 18 and IS 1893 6.3.4), and earthquake to IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 (zones, soil types I-III, R, I, Ah = (Z/2)(I/R)(Sa/g), Ta, the least base shear, Qi by hi², scaling to VB, drift 0.004, irregularities). Materials are not covered yet: concrete, steel, masonry, timber, foundations, detailing, services and every other table come from BNBC 2020 (the pack this one extends) until the IS material packs exist. Every value names its clause; VERIFY.md lists them for checking against the printed codes.
